main_text.p: vertetur, in tam fertili medi-cinę agro, à diligentissimis illis, qui me præcesserunt, mesforibus[?], relicta spicilegia, non mediocrem prouentus accessionem rei medicæ fa-ctura, postremus ego & infi-mus messor, siciliirem[?]. Publi-ca igitur vtilitas, cupiditas voluntati meæ satisfaciendi, & auctores viri graues, qui-bus hoc scriptum meum pla-cere & probari intellexi, me ad hunc fœtum excluden-dum compulerunt, cuius ca-put ac pectus, vobis, Serenis-simi Principes offero atque commendo, humiliter rogi-

page.notes: Running head "Dedicatoria" is set in small capitals with a decorative spacing; transcribed as printed. Two words are doubtful: "mesforibus" (possibly "messoribus") and "siciliirem" (letters unclear at the scan's resolution), both marked [?]. The small mark at the lower left is a stain or show-through and is not transcribed.
